name: tiktok-live-commerce
description: Monorepo JokkoLive — apps/api (NestJS) + apps/dashboard (React/Vite). Chaque app gère ses propres deps (PAS de workspaces npm pour éviter le hoisting qui casse Firebase App Hosting / Cloud Run buildpacks).

scripts.build: cd apps/api && npm run build && cd ../dashboard && npm run build
scripts.install:all: cd apps/api && npm install && cd ../dashboard && npm install
